title: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated…
description: The Members WordPress plugin versions before 3.3.1 have a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to read comments on posts restricted by user roles via the Latest Comments block. This occurs because the plugin's get_comment_excerpt() function bypasses filtering, exposing restricted comments, post titles, and links to unauthorized visitors.
